patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,9 +1,105 @@
-class BowlingGame:
-    def __init__(self):
-        pass
-
-    def roll(self, pins):
-        pass
-
-    def score(self):
-        pass
+class BowlingGame:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.rolls = []
+        self.current_frame = 1
+        self.frame_rolls = []  # Rolls in current frame
+        self.frames_completed = 0
+        self.game_over = False
+
+    def roll(self, pins):
+        if self.game_over:
+            raise ValueError("Cannot roll after game is over")
+        
+        if pins < 0:
+            raise ValueError("Negative roll is invalid")
+        
+        if pins > 10:
+            raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+        
+        # Check if current roll is valid based on previous rolls in frame
+        if len(self.frame_rolls) == 1:
+            # Second roll of frame - check if total exceeds 10 (except 10th frame special case)
+            if self.current_frame == 10:
+                # In 10th frame, second roll can be up to 10, but special rules apply
+                if self.frame_rolls[0] == 10:  # First was strike
+                    # Second roll can be anything up to 10
+                    pass
+                elif self.frame_rolls[0] + pins > 10:
+                    raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+            else:
+                # Regular frame - first roll + second roll can't exceed 10
+                if self.frame_rolls[0] + pins > 10:
+                    raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+        
+        self.rolls.append(pins)
+        self.frame_rolls.append(pins)
+        
+        # Check if frame is complete
+        self._check_frame_completion()
+
+    def _check_frame_completion(self):
+        if self.game_over:
+            return
+            
+        if self.current_frame < 10:
+            # Regular frames (1-9)
+            if len(self.frame_rolls) == 2:  # Two rolls completed
+                self.frames_completed += 1
+                self.current_frame += 1
+                self.frame_rolls = []
+            elif len(self.frame_rolls) == 1 and self.frame_rolls[0] == 10:  # Strike
+                self.frames_completed += 1
+                self.current_frame += 1
+                self.frame_rolls = []
+        else:
+            # 10th frame - special rules
+            if len(self.frame_rolls) == 3:  # Three rolls completed
+                self.frames_completed += 1
+                self.game_over = True
+            elif len(self.frame_rolls) == 2:
+                # Check if we need a third roll
+                if self.frame_rolls[0] == 10 or sum(self.frame_rolls) == 10:
+                    # Strike or spare - need third roll
+                    pass
+                else:
+                    # Open frame - game over
+                    self.frames_completed += 1
+                    self.game_over = True
+            elif len(self.frame_rolls) == 1 and self.frame_rolls[0] < 10:
+                # First roll was not strike - need second roll
+                pass
+
+    def score(self):
+        if self.frames_completed < 10:
+            raise ValueError("Score cannot be taken until the end of the game")
+        
+        total_score = 0
+        roll_index = 0
+        
+        for frame in range(10):
+            if roll_index >= len(self.rolls):
+                break
+                
+            if self.rolls[roll_index] == 10:  # Strike
+                # Strike score: 10 + next two rolls
+                frame_score = 10
+                if roll_index + 1 < len(self.rolls):
+                    frame_score += self.rolls[roll_index + 1]
+                if roll_index + 2 < len(self.rolls):
+                    frame_score += self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+                total_score += frame_score
+                roll_index += 1
+            else:
+                # Check for spare or open frame
+                frame_rolls = self.rolls[roll_index:roll_index + 2]
+                frame_score = sum(frame_rolls)
+                
+                if frame_score == 10:  # Spare
+                    # Spare score: 10 + next one roll
+                    if roll_index + 2 < len(self.rolls):
+                        frame_score += self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+                
+                total_score += frame_score
+                roll_index += 2
+        
+        return total_score
